native_pair_counts.query:
SELECT p.post_type, lang.slug AS language, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS published_items, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lang.slug='tr' AND en.ID IS NULL THEN p.ID END) AS tr_without_published_en
FROM `152006258`.`wp_posts` p
JOIN `152006258`.`wp_term_relationships` lr ON lr.object_id=p.ID
JOIN `152006258`.`wp_term_taxonomy` lt ON lt.term_taxonomy_id=lr.term_taxonomy_id AND lt.taxonomy='language'
JOIN `152006258`.`wp_terms` lang ON lang.term_id=lt.term_id AND lang.slug IN ('tr','en')
LEFT JOIN (SELECT gr.object_id, gt.description FROM `152006258`.`wp_term_relationships` gr JOIN `152006258`.`wp_term_taxonomy` gt ON gt.term_taxonomy_id=gr.term_taxonomy_id AND gt.taxonomy='post_translations') pairs ON pairs.object_id=p.ID
LEFT JOIN `152006258`.`wp_posts` en ON en.ID=CASE WHEN LOCATE('s:2:"en";i:',pairs.description)>0 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pairs.description,'s:2:"en";i:',-1),';',1) AS UNSIGNED) ELSE 0 END AND en.post_status='publish'
WHERE p.post_status='publish' AND p.post_type IN ('post','page')
GROUP BY p.post_type,lang.slug ORDER BY p.post_type,lang.slug;
